note: evidence: O = first-party official, R = research paper/preprint, M = media/secondary. weight biases ranking. topical = the feed only publishes Physical AI material, so its items need no anchor term. lang = the language a feed publishes in, when it is not English; its titles and excerpts are quoted as written.

filters.repeat_note: an item already shown within this many days is not picked again; it must cover max_age_days and arxiv.lookback_days, or a post still inside the pool is picked a second time the day it leaves the guard
filters.caps_note: per_source and per_evidence reserve room on the shortlist for other feeds and evidence classes; slots they leave empty are filled afterwards from what they held back, in rank order

arxiv.lookback_note: the API dates a paper by its first submission; Monday's announcement carries papers submitted from Thursday 18:00 UTC, so a three-day lookback missed them
